expected_semantics.reason: THE row that settles the basis. 11002 on the same page prints no case note and 11003 prints 一盒12支 — a box of twelve — and both are HKD$90 against HKD$140 retail. One price cannot buy one bottle on one row and twelve on the next while both quote the same retail. 一盒12支 is therefore the case configuration, not what the price buys, and no sellable count is read from it.

A bed table: five colours, one size, one price, a different code each. The page names the product once in its heading and never in the row, so 顏色 carries the whole distinction — without it these rows differ only by code. 49x36x17.5cm is the bed's dimensions, a content measure, and not a count of anything.
0.2 L is how much the container holds. The colours are printed as filled circles rather than words, and are kept verbatim — reading them as a quantity would turn a swatch into a number.
